research.title: Occlusion-Aware Temporal Consistency for Video Segmentation
bullets: Formulated whether excluding unreliable frame correspondences improves temporal segmentation consistency, and led development of an occlusion-aware consistency objective.
Compared masked and unmasked temporal supervision under controlled occlusions, examining segmentation accuracy, boundary stability, and failure cases near moving objects.

research.title: Spatially Adaptive Feature Alignment for Visual Anomaly Detection
bullets: Investigated whether local feature alignment distinguishes surface defects from benign texture shifts, and led development of a patchwise matching approach.
Evaluated nearest-neighbor and spatially constrained matching baselines, analyzing localization errors under illumination changes, repetitive textures, and small geometric misalignments.

research.title: Boundary-Guided Learning with Sparse Segmentation Labels
bullets: Asked how image boundaries can constrain learning from sparse annotations, and led development of an edge-weighted label propagation objective.
Compared propagation and consistency-based baselines using controlled annotation masks, assessing boundary adherence and sensitivity to misleading texture edges.

research.title: Uncertainty-Aware Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation under Visual Shift
bullets: Formulated how class-dependent uncertainty affects segmentation adaptation, and led development of calibrated pseudo-label selection with class-specific confidence thresholds.
Designed calibration, corruption, and selective prediction evaluations, comparing thresholding alternatives and examining confidence failures across image regions and semantic classes.

work.title: Image Ingestion Validation and Preprocessing
bullets: Implemented assigned image validation and resizing routines in an existing ingestion pipeline, handling unsupported formats, invalid dimensions, and corrupted inputs.
Added regression tests for preprocessing behavior and investigated reported failures by tracing input validation errors through existing processing stages.

projects.title: Comparing Local Features for Image Matching
bullets: Implemented gradient-based local descriptors and nearest-neighbor matching, comparing correspondence quality against normalized image patches under rotation and illumination changes.
Evaluated geometric verification with robust homography estimation, inspecting mismatches caused by repetitive patterns, weak texture, and viewpoint differences.

projects.title: Image Classification under Limited Training Data
bullets: Implemented convolutional classification baselines with standard augmentation and pretrained feature extraction, using consistent training partitions for comparative evaluation.
Compared learning curves, classwise errors, and calibration across training subsets, examining sensitivity to augmentation choices and frozen versus trainable features.

projects.title: Classical and Learned Approaches to Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented Gaussian filtering, patch-based averaging, and a convolutional denoiser, comparing their behavior on images with controlled additive noise.
Evaluated reconstruction fidelity and edge preservation across noise conditions, documenting oversmoothing, residual artifacts, and differences between matched and mismatched training noise.
